current.text: McDaniels is a projected starter for Minnesota. Anthony Edwards, LaMelo Ball and Rudy Gobert are the other set starters.
Coach Finch said McDaniels will play some power forward, but he probably will not start there or play all his minutes there. Minnesota has little frontcourt depth.
Julius Randle and Naz Reid were traded away for LaMelo Ball. Donte DiVincenzo will miss most of the season.
Minnesota signed Jonathan Kuminga, who is expected to start and will take shots.
With Randle and Reid gone, his usage should go up. The Kuminga signing takes back some of that gain.
Experts disagree on his price. One calls a rank of about 74 fair and doubts he reaches 20 percent usage. Another lists him as a sleeper who should beat the Kuminga hit.
In the latest mock draft he went at pick 77. The expert sees upside: if a teammate misses time, his usage spikes. The same expert is a little worried about the team overall.
Minnesota plays only two games in the week starting March 15, 2027. That is week 20, inside our fantasy playoffs.

durable.text: His usage has gone up in each of the last three seasons.
He has a balanced category profile with no weak category. He helps most in blocks, steals and FG% for a forward.

note: McDaniels is a cheap, balanced forward who fits every build. Projections have him at about 51% FG with 1.1 steals and 1.0 blocks, and no category hurts you. He went for 1 USD in our league last season, and the sites price him at 4 to 6 USD (rank 84 to 90), so he is a good late target at 3 to 6 USD. Early in the season, check how his usage holds up next to Kuminga and LaMelo Ball and how often he plays power forward. Also plan around Minnesota's two-game week in playoff week 20.
